meta.name: Hostage
meta.description: When the British prime minister's husband is kidnapped and the French president starts receiving threats, both leaders must face an impossible choice.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: With the country in crisis and her husband held hostage, the newly-elected British prime minister turns to the visiting French president for help.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Dalton looks for ways to rescue her husband without informing the cabinet. But without Toussaint's help, there's no chance of saving him.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: As the UK terror threat level rises to critical, the kidnappers go quiet. The two heads of state discuss a deal that could save them both.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: A grieving Dalton faces her mutinous cabinet and Toussaint confronts her furious husband. Despite everything, the leaders finally reach an agreement.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: A state of emergency is declared across the country. With the military in control, Dalton must find who's behind it all before it's too late.

meta.slogan: I will not negotiate. I will not be held...
